skeleton.$description: Loading placeholder — a shimmering neutral block standing in for content that hasn't arrived (a table row, an avatar, a line of text). One recipe, shaped by the consumer's width/height; a `line` height token for text rows and a `--circle` modifier for avatar placeholders. The shimmer is a brand-neutral gray sweep (base gray.100 → a brighter band), matching the flat aesthetic — no spinner, no brand color. Its driving use case is the Staff Message Center's 'Loading more threads…' list tail and initial table/skeleton rows (MC v2 epic Part 1's standard loading pattern).

base.$description: gray.100 — the resting block color; visible on a white card without shouting.

highlight.$description: The brighter band that sweeps across (white) — base → highlight → base is the shimmer.

radius.$description: 4px for lines/blocks; the --circle modifier overrides to radius.full for avatar placeholders.

duration.$description: One shimmer sweep. A literal, not tokenized — no motion scale exists in this system yet, same call as Drawer/Modal's transition timings.
